pages.text: All spells in this book are Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks spells. Find or craft their scrolls, scribe them into a spellbook at an Inscription Table, equip the book and cast with Iron's $(l)Cast Selected Spell$() key (V by default) or the spell wheel (R).
pages.title: Learning and Casting

pages.text: Each spell has a minimum rarity: a scroll of lower rarity cannot hold it. Higher spell levels raise damage, radius and duration and cost a little more mana.

Spells with a $(l)Long$() cast keep you casting for their cast time first. $(l)Toggle$() spells turn on with one cast and off with the next. Barrage stops when you cast it again, release right-click with a staff, or press Stop.
Tooltips in the spellbook show each spell's damage at your current spell power.
